title: Living Roots Wine & Co.
about: Living Roots Wine & Co. is the winery of Sebastian and Colleen Hardy, founded in 2016 and split between the Finger Lakes and South Australia. Seb is a sixth-generation winemaker: his ancestor Thomas Hardy arrived in South Australia in 1850 and planted some of its first vines, and his father, Geoff Hardy, planted K1, the first vineyard in Kuitpo, a cool, high subregion at the southern end of the Adelaide Hills. Colleen, from the Rochester area, met Seb while working a vintage in Australia. In 2023 Halliday’s Wine Companion named Living Roots Australia’s Best New Winery.
Eden pours eleven of their wines. Find them on the wine list in our menu.
